For a 13-minute run, almost all of that $15 is context being re-read on every call plus whatever helpers it spawned. None of that is in the 7.2k.

This only bites where crew prices a run itself rather than taking the CLI's figure, so it never touched your $15.36, but it under-reports everywhere it does apply.
